policy.build_gated: Configured and compiled by the required validation workflow on every change.
policy.smoke_gated: Build-gated and exercised by an automated process-level starter, native-extension, multiplayer, or content-showcase smoke test.
policy.source_capable: The checked BuildTools registry exposes a target, but the required workflow does not exercise it.
policy.not_in_public_matrix: No supported validation target is published for this application/platform combination.
